proposed_capability: Expose passive, bounded, explicitly registered native runtime recovery notices from InstalledPlayerRuntime.cycle to a supplied exact-build adapter port; classify only known missing evidence/implementation states, not normal player yields; preserve existing game control and source-vs-runtime proof. Host adapter correlates notices with private SCL receipt separately.

competing_theses.evidence: Per-frame writes, private data exposure and unbounded work.

Host can join runtime notice with owned Play receipt only after independent process/run correlation.
